about: The painted maps the Mirefen tavern wears. Outside it stands in the look of the hand-built painted kit (scripts/assets/eastbrook_houses/, its moss set), which every building of Fenbridge beside it wears: kit_maps.mjs writes the kit's own rubble (TownStone) and slates (TownRoof) into tex/ under the tones the town draws them with, and regrades the tavern's oak (TownTimber), brushwork kept, to the kit's red oak a shade darker. The limewash (TownPlaster), the boards (TownFloor), the dressed stone (TownDressed) and the garnet cloth (TownCloth) are the Fenrire maps the tavern always wore (the ClaudeCraft Studio repository's scripts/assets/blender_tidehold/town_tex_painted_var/fenrire/ maps, the boards regraded by regrade_map.mjs's floor ramp to a weathered brown), kept because the common room scored better with them. The regraded and the kept maps keep their Fenrire normal maps; the stone and the slates are new paintings and carry none. Every map tiles seamlessly: its wrap is no sharper, nor any stronger in tone, than the lines inside it. yards is the town kit's repeat (bl_town_lib.py K) at the scale Fenbridge stands its inn (1.2), so the stones, the slates, the grain and the limewash read at the size the town's own buildings show them (the boards and the cloth, indoors, keep the kit's); normalStrength is the kit's normal strength, baked into the shipped normal map; roughness is the painted buildings' own. headroom: a painted face's colour (its tint over the map and the warm light baked over that) is stored divided by it, so the light can lift the paint up to that many times the map before the colour clamps; build.mjs writes the linear factor that undoes it (vertexColourScale, 1 / srgbToLinear(1 / headroom)) into each painted material's extras, and the runtime multiplies the colour by it. tavern_texture.py lays them on in Blender, build.mjs embeds them at each texture tier. TavernProps is the props' atlas (props/build_atlas.mjs): the painted maps of the real models dressing the room (the trophies, the shelves, the barrels, the chandelier, the candles, the banners and the rest made with Tripo, shields from the game's armoury), each in its own 512 tile; its faces carry their own UVs into it, so it has no repeat, and its scale ([across, down]) sizes it at twice each tier's colour size across and five times down (2048 by 5120 at the full tier) so every piece keeps its tile's detail.
